clips.title: Utility Workers Clearing Storm Debris on Road
clips.creator: Ibrahim Bennett
clips.candidate_role: Selected positive replay: visible road obstruction / utility work zone
clips.review_notes: Eleven sampled frames show utility trucks occupying the roadway, yellow tape spanning the road, and branches/debris on pavement. Use the label road obstruction / work zone. The clip does not establish a mechanical stall, collision, injury, incident onset, clearance, or complete lane count. Slight camera movement; no calibrated coordinates. Source describes storm cleanup, which is source context rather than a diagnosis from pixels.
clips.review_method: One-frame-per-second contact sheet inspected, plus a full-size frame at 5 seconds; complete original decoded during transcode and complete derived video decoded separately. No model inference run.
clips.attribution: Utility Workers Clearing Storm Debris on Road — Ibrahim Bennett / Pexels. Pexels License. Demo version resized to 1920x1080 and re-encoded to H.264; full duration and playback speed retained.
clips.distribution_notes: Keep the raw download out of public source repositories and stock/download libraries. Display within the Clearway evidence/review experience with source and replay labels.
